text:
NATO jets intercepted and shot down a drone in Lithuanian airspace, marking a significant escalation in the conflict and raising concerns about global stability [NATO jets down drone over Lithuania](https://news.google.?oc=5). This military action coincides with intensified energy infrastructure attacks by both Russia and Ukraine, including strikes on oil refineries and facilities near Kyiv. The spillover effects of the war are evident in diplomatic pressures and security discussions at the United Nations Security Council, highlighting the urgent need for effective counter-drone measures in both military and civilian contexts.

In the United States, the Federal Aviation Administration is launching Phase 2 of its BEYOND drone program, planning to double its current size by adding up to eight state, local, tribal, and territorial participants [FAA launches Phase 2 of BEYOND drone program](https://www.aol.com/articles/drones-could-buzzing-across-americas-203759000.html). This expansion aims to gather airborne coverage data for command and control and safety services, supported by a Federal Communications Commission waiver that enables nationwide testing of cellular networks for drone safety. Concurrently, Birdstop is tapping Detroit’s automotive supply chain to scale U.S. drone manufacturing, leveraging domestic components and high-volume production expertise to support the growing unmanned systems industry.

Waymo is significantly expanding its autonomous vehicle operations, announcing plans to launch fully driverless taxi services in Tokyo by 2027 with up to 100 vehicles [Waymo accelerates global robotaxi expansion](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxQQ1JfUlNwRFh4SnFxU0VYVjZ3V0huZVdfXzRoYnNLUnFqVEZfbWZQNGRhQS1Wejc1OGwzeV84cWFCWEJuMjB0NU5reHJ1czFMbFFkRC1UTmVsRXhMVHRoMkFwdkhJNlIzdm1wM0FHUVRiVmhwQmotSVBYWmpDSlVVeDNIYlRDdXJ0UGN6YzJPY2wzanhRcUlFdVg0dTVma1NiVDZv?oc=5). The company also secured a legal victory in Santa Monica, strengthening its operational framework for autonomous vehicles. This move reflects broader industry adoption, as Hyundai partners with Nvidia for a 2028 driver-assist system and Lidl deploys Level 4 autonomous trucks in Germany, indicating growing confidence in autonomous technology despite ongoing safety debates.

Advanced air mobility progress continues with Joby Aviation demonstrating eVTOL integration in Arizona and planning upcoming flights in Wichita, reinforcing its leadership position [Joby Aviation demonstrates eVTOL integration](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxPY3VQVkFxZUZfVVEzTVBuLTlrTUN0ckRBSmhGSk1wX1dlcm9sZjZaeGpiY0NvSTVvTXEwSjFOM011WS1Xb1FsV0EteEZpZnhSMDVKRWhQMGktb19feUozMklnMDJzYThVTXVKRWx4Um1keDVSTzdENEF1MTllTXNEZ0xmMlRPcUF4MWNIOHNKMlNiWEc5WDdwRFJPS2FHd0FMTlo2bHlwcDlzZUdFc0FYcndNMUMwYXE1VHc?oc=5). Surf Air Mobility highlighted its role as a commercial platform for Advanced Air Mobility at the Federal Aviation Administration's Project Nexus event. Meanwhile, the British Army has deployed the Halo Shield drone detection system after rapid trials, and the United States Air Force is developing a Point Defense career path to enhance counter-drone capabilities, signaling increased investment in counter-UAS technologies.
